description: Train a new version of a demand model on your workspace's own quote outcomes (reported, or inferred from what buyers did next). A held-out fifth of the quotes scores it against one pooled demand curve, and its metrics say by how much it did better. promote never (the default) stores it as a candidate, always makes it active, and if_better makes it active only when it beats the pooled curve and the active version. Answers 422 with the number of outcomes when there are too few to train on, and 422 for a price model. Answers 404 not_released while hosted models (the hosted-pricing-models release) are not switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with function publish scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

model_id.description: The hosted model's id: id on a list_hosted_models result.

promote.description: Whether the new version becomes active. Defaults to never.

name: train_hosted_model
